channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Bursa Malaysia extends gains at midday
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Bursa Malaysia continued its uptrend momentum at midday against a backdrop of mostly lower regional markets following mixed cues from Wall Street overnight, said an analyst.

item.title: No progress, so Rafizi may ask cops to halt probe into son's attack
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Datuk Seri Rafizi Ramli says he may ask the authorities to stop probing the attack on his son, citing a lack of progress after six months.

item.title: Petronas outlook flags selective O&G activity in 2026
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Several oil and gas subsegments in Malaysia are expected to see increased activity in 2026, despite a projected decline in capital expenditure, Maybank Investment Bank Bhd (Maybank IB) said, citing Petroliam Nasional Bhd's (Petronas) Activity Outlook 2026-2028.

item.title: Loan shark victims report brutal assault over ballooning debts
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Two victims have detailed the harrowing violence and extortion they faced after failing to settle debts with loan shark syndicates that ballooned by more than five times the original sums.

item.title: Trump sues IRS, Treasury Department for US$10bil over tax return leak
item.description: NEW YORK: US President Donald Trump on Thursday sued the Internal Revenue Service and Treasury Department for US$10 billion over the disclosure of his tax returns to the media in 2019 and 2020.

item.title: Man declared bankrupt over RM15mil in tax arrears
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: A 51-year-old man has been declared bankrupt for failing to settle over RM15 million in income tax arrears accumulated over seven years.

item.title: Herry produces a more lethal Aaron-Wooi Yik for All England
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: National men's doubles head coach Herry IP expects Aaron Chia–Soh Wooi Yik to reach the All England final and fight for the prestigious crown in March.

item.title: MACC probing alleged misuse of zakat funds to buy Penang land
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission is probing the possible abuse of power by a senior Penang government official over the purchase of land using zakat funds.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: 'I have to keep fighting': Teen star Farel Prayoga on domestic turmoil, depleted savings
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Indonesian singing sensation Farel Prayoga is currently navigating a turbulent emotional period following a public falling-out with his father, Joko Suyoto.

item.title: Son of Norway crown princess to stand trial for rape
item.description: OSLO: In the biggest scandal to rock Norway's monarchy, the son of Crown Princess Mette-Marit goes on trial on Tuesday, accused of raping four women, as well as drug and assault offences.
